definitions.explanation: An artificial body of water for swimming.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧プール⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a pool at school.
I go to the pool in summer.

notes:
プール is a loanword from English "pool," referring to swimming pools.

TYPES:
- ⟦{室内|しつない}→室内：03061_shitsunai⟧プール: indoor pool
- ⟦{屋外|おくがい}→屋外：04136_okugai⟧プール: outdoor pool
- ⟦{温水|おんすい}→温水：27514_onsui⟧プール: heated pool
- ⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧プール: public municipal pool
- ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧プール: school pool

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- プール⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{泳|およ}ぐ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧: to swim in the pool
- プール⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to the pool
- プール⟦{開|びら}き→開く：noentry⟧: pool opening (for the season)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Most schools have pools, and swimming lessons are part of PE curriculum. Public pools (⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧プール) are common and affordable.
